title: Rank Teams by Votes
description: Given a list of strings votes, rank the teams based on their position preferences.
pseudocode:
1. let ranks = new Map()
2. for each vote in votes:
3.   for i in range(vote.length):
4.     team = vote[i], rank = i
5.     ranks[team][rank]++
6. let teams = Object.keys(ranks).sort((a, b) => {
7.   for i in range(len): if ranks[a][i] != ranks[b][i] return ranks[b][i] - ranks[a][i]
8.   return a.localeCompare(b)
9. })
